OpenTelemetryMetrics.Title: OpenTelemetry Metrics
OpenTelemetryMetrics.Description: Explore this host’s instrument registry, exact tag series, retained samples and diagnostic exports.

Banner.PerInstanceHint: Per-instance, in-memory only. For production retention, configure OTLP or Prometheus.

Status.LoadFailed: Failed to load the metrics snapshot.

Histogram.WindowHelp: Percentiles, range and bucket counts describe only finite observations in the selected series’ retained window. They are not lifetime totals or service-level thresholds.
Histogram.Excluded: {0} retained nonfinite observations are excluded from these statistics.
Histogram.BucketHelp: Counts belong to individual intervals. The first includes its lower bound; later intervals exclude the lower bound and include the upper bound. Bar lengths compare counts within this window.

Overflow.Title: Overflow
Overflow.Message: Tag-set count exceeded MaxTagSetsPerInstrument; some series are not displayed.

Workbench.Intro: Explore a published instrument, choose its exact tag series, and inspect the measurements behind it.
Workbench.ReadingPaused: View reads paused · host collection continues
Workbench.ReadingActive: Reading retained evidence · host collection is independent
Workbench.Unavailable: This host has not registered the OpenTelemetry UI module and its in-process collector dependency.
Workbench.RetainedAfterFailure: The previous successful view remains available. Its capture times have not advanced.
Workbench.NoSnapshot: No successful snapshot is available yet.
Workbench.Scope: Current host resource and whole-registry coverage
Workbench.ExportHelp: Copies the whole adopted snapshot, independent of filters. JSON omits sample history; diagnostic Prometheus text describes retained-window gauges. These are not SDK scrape results.

Registry.Title: Instrument registry
Registry.Empty: No matching instruments have been published to this collector. Check the host’s selected meter patterns and instrumentation.
Registry.NoMatches: Try another name or choose a different meter. The resource summary still describes the whole snapshot.

Dossier.Title: Selected instrument
Dossier.Choose: Select a published instrument from the registry to explore its exact series and retained measurements.
Dossier.Overflow: {0} observations for additional tag sets were dropped after reaching the bound. Retained series continue collecting; this is not total transport loss.
Dossier.Unmeasured: This instrument exists, but has no retained tag series. A missing observation is not a measured zero.

Series.Title: Choose a series
Series.DeltaHelp: Delta compares the last two retained observations. It is not a per-second rate or the change since the previous view read; one point cannot establish a delta.
Series.PlotHelp: Every finite retained value is positioned by its actual observation time. Nonfinite values remain in the ledger and break the line; the plot does not invent missing samples.
Series.Omitted: {0} nonfinite values are retained in the ledger and omitted from plotting.
Series.NoSamples: No retained observations are available for this series.
Series.NoFiniteSamples: The retained values are all nonfinite. Inspect the raw ledger; there is no finite plot or distribution.
Series.HistogramBasis: Histogram samples are raw recorded values. Distribution statistics use finite values in this bounded retained window, not lifetime SDK aggregates.
Series.CounterBasis: For this direct counter, recorded increments accumulate into the retained values. Eviction bounds the observation history, not the cumulative value.
Series.MeasurementBasis: Values preserve each recorded or observable callback measurement in the declared unit. No page-refresh normalization is applied.
Series.Choose: Choose a retained tag series to open its measurement evidence.

Ledger.Title: Sample ledger
Ledger.Help: All retained samples remain inspectable, including nonfinite values. Raw values preserve the original declared unit.

Inspector.Title: Sample evidence
Inspector.Frozen: This inspector is frozen from one successful view read. Host collection and later refreshes do not replace its values.
Inspector.OpenFailed: The sample inspector could not be opened.
